courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Theoretical Foundation of Teaching Chinese
courses.description: This course aims to: explore the relationship between the stages of psychological development of children and Chinese Language learning; analyse the relationship between the properties of Chinese Language and methods for cultivating language ability; apply the knowledge of linguistic in teaching Chinese; understand the principles and theories of Chinese Language listening, speaking, reading and writing training; explore development theories of language ability, such as Chinese character literacy studies, theories of Chinese language syntax, and language articulation studies, etc.
courses.feedback_evaluation: Revised course questionnaire and reflection of teachers

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Language, Thought and Writing
courses.description: This course emphasizes the characters and essence of Chinese language, the relationship between language and thought, and language Communication skills. These are supported by writing exercises that are conducive to effective communication in a variety of academic and professional areas.
courses.enrollment_requirement: Not for students who have taken LEDC2610
courses.feedback_evaluation: The colleagues in the Chinese Language Team will work collaboratively to review the progress of course implementation and update the content of the course on a regular basis. The sources of feedback information are mainly from course materials, occasional student feedback and lesson observation on a voluntary basis.

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Psychology in Chinese Language Teaching
courses.description: This course introduces different psychological theories in Chinese language teaching. It aims at enhancing students' language teaching abilities through applying the principles of these theories in their instructional design and practices. This course will include topics of language acquisition; language development; psychological processes involved in word recognition, comprehension, writing, and conversational interaction; language learning and cognitive development; and motivation theories in language learning.
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能：
1. 理解與語文教學有關的心理學理論；
2. 將理論應用在教學設計和實踐上，以提高語文教學能力。
courses.course_syllabus:
• 影響語文習得的因素
• 語文能力的發展
• 識字、閱讀、寫作和聽說交際的心理過程
• 語文學習與策略運用
• 語文學習的動機理論
• 語文學習的評估
courses.feedback_evaluation: 學員的意見會經課堂/課後討論、電郵及學期末科目評鑒收集。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Methods of Chinese Language Teaching I (Putonghua as Medium of Instruction)
courses.description: The course introduces the fundamental theories of using Putonghua as a medium of instruction in teaching Chinese. It will focus on the background of using Putonghua as a medium of instruction in teaching Chinese, the theories of curriculum integration, the review of current development and practical experiences, and the exploration of an ideal mode of using Chinese and Putonghua as mediums of instruction in teaching.

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Methods of Teaching Putonghua as a Subject
courses.description: The course aims at helping learners acquire the theories and methodology of teaching Putonghua as a subject in schools, and explore the principle of curriculum and instructional materials development; testing of Putonghua proficiency; using Putonghua as a medium of instruction by Putonghua teachers, etc. Learners must pass a Putonghua proficiency test before taking the course.

- 通過微格教學，學生掌握了教授普通話的基本原則與技巧

- 通過撰寫研習報告，學生進行反思，教學上得到新的經驗和啟示

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Literature and Language Education
courses.description: This course aims at helping learners master the basic teaching skills and develop the ability of instructional design in Chinese language education. Topics aims to explore: the meaning of Chinese Literature and Language; a comparative analysis of Chinese Literature curriculum and Chinese Language curriculum; key qualities of Chinese Literature and its use values; learning and teaching goals of Chinese Literature; pedagogies and teaching materials development for Chinese Literature teaching, and a review of Chinese language and literature education in Hong Kong.
courses.enrollment_requirement: Not for students who have taken LEDC4620
courses.learning_outcomes:
- 明白中國文學教育與中國語文教育的關係
- 掌握中國文學教育課程特徵、關鍵內容及價值所在
- 掌握中國文科的教材選取及教學組織
- 掌握本港中國文學課程、教學的評估原則
courses.course_syllabus:
- 文學與語文的涵義；
- 文學課程與語文課程的比較分析；
- 文學的要素及其功能價值；
- 文學的學習目的與教學目標；
- 文學的教材與教法；
- 本港語文與文學教育評議。
courses.feedback_evaluation: 學生對課程之意見將通過平日溝通、網站交流、期末問卷調查反映。

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Putonghua Teaching Methodology
courses.description: This course provides an overview of the Putonghua teaching theories and methodology, curriculum design and development in Hong Kong. Topics covered include (1) the subject content of Putonghua teaching; (2) application of language teaching methods in teaching Putonghua; (3) teaching of Pinyin system; (4) teaching of listening and oral reading; (5) teaching of speaking; (6) analysis of school-based Putonghua curriculum.
courses.learning_outcomes:
1. 了解香港普通話課程的發展與現狀。
2. 掌握普通話科的教學內容和課程設計。
3. 掌握普通話科不同教學內容的教學設計和有效實施不同的教學方法。
courses.course_syllabus:
1. 普通話教學的性質和學科內容
1. 1 立足香港的普通話教學——發展與現狀
1. 2 香港中、小學普通話課程的設計與教學實施

2. 語言教學法在普通話教學中的應用
2. 1 語法翻譯法和直接法
2. 2 聽說法和交際法

3. 普通話課堂的教學設計
3. 1 課堂教學語言的轉變
3. 2 粵、普詞彙與句式的對比教學
3. 3 拼音的教與學
3. 4 聽、說、朗讀的教與學

4. 普通話校本課程介紹與分析
4. 1 小學普通話的課程與教學
4. 2 中學普通話的課程與教學

5. 微格教學
5. 1 微格教學演示
5. 2 微格教學總結與分析

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Oral Skills of Chinese Language Teachers
courses.description: This course aims at helping student teachers improve their oral expression and communication skills in Chinese language teaching, and develop oral skills of students in Chinese language. Topics covered in this course include: (1) the relationship between the language development and cognitive development; (2) the difference between spoken and written language; (3) the effect of the teachers' oral proficiency on students' language ability; (4) the basic oral expression skill and the ability to manipulate the articulator; (5) the complementary use of body language and spoken language; (6) skills for the purposes of narrating and describing, reading aloud, public speaking, explanation, questioning, and debating; (7) the Cantonese phonetic system; (8) common articulation errors in Cantonese and ways for improvement.

courses.subject: CLED
courses.title: Special Topics in Chinese Language Education
courses.description: This course is designed for students who wish to have an in-depth exploration of special topics in Chinese language teaching. The course aims to respond to students' professional development needs through broadening their exploration and enhancing their pedagogical knowledge and skills in different areas of Chinese language education.
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成課程後，學員將能夠：
1. 認識與專題相關的學理；
2. 掌握與專題相關的有效教學和評估策略；
3. 應用研習專題所得，配合本課程其他學科學習內容，設計教學課題並試驗實踐。
（具體學習成果視乎專題內容由任課教師自行釐訂）
